1: // Pixel Runner – simple endless runner
2: // Targets a canvas with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
12:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
13: 
14:   // Game constants
15:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
16:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
17:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 20;
18:   const SCROLL_SPEED = 4;
19:   const OBSTACLE_SPACING = 200; // distance between obstacles
20: 
21:   // State
22:   let playerY = height - PLAYER_SIZE;
23:   let playerVy = 0;
24:   let isJumping = false;
25:   let offsetX = 0;
26:   let obstacles = []; // {x, type: 'gap'|'spike'}
27:   let lastObstacleX = width;
28:   let score = 0;
29:   let gameOver = false;
30: 
31:   // Load sounds
32:   const jumpSound = new Audio('https://assets.codepen.io/6093407/jump.wav');
33:   const hitSound = new Audio('https://assets.codepen.io/6093407/hit.wav');
34: 
35:   // Input
36:   const jump = () => {
37:     if (playerY >= height - PLAYER_SIZE) {
38:       playerVy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
39:       jumpSound.currentTime = 0;
40:       jumpSound.play();
41:     }
42:   };
43:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space' || e.key === ' ') jump(); });
44:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', jump);
45: 
46:   // Helper to spawn obstacles
47:   const addObstacle = () => {
48:     const type = Math.random() < 0.7 ? 'gap' : 'spike';
49:     obstacles.push({ x: lastObstacleX + OBSTACLE_SPACING, type });
50:     lastObstacleX += OBSTACLE_SPACING;
51:   };
52:   // Fill initial obstacles
53:   for (let i = 0; i < Math.ceil(width / OBSTACLE_SPACING) + 2; i++) addObstacle();
54: 
55:   const update = () => {
56:     if (gameOver) return;
57:     // Player physics
58:     playerVy += GRAVITY;
59:     playerY += playerVy;
60:     if (playerY > height - PLAYER_SIZE) {
61:       playerY = height - PLAYER_SIZE;
62:       playerVy = 0;
63:     }
64: 
65:     // Move obstacles
66:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= SCROLL_SPEED);
67:     // Remove off‑screen and add new ones
68:     if (obstacles[0].x < -40) {
69:       obstacles.shift();
70:       addObstacle();
71:       score++;
72:     }
73: 
74:     // Collision detection
75:     const playerRect = { x: 40, y: playerY, w: PLAYER_SIZE, h: PLAYER_SIZE };
76:     for (const o of obstacles) {
77:       if (o.type === 'gap') {
78:         // gap is a hole in the ground; if player is over it and on ground, lose
79:         const gapStart = o.x;
80:         const gapEnd = o.x + 40; // gap width
81:         if (playerRect.x + playerRect.w > gapStart && playerRect.x < gapEnd && playerY + PLAYER_SIZE >= height) {
82:           gameOver = true;
83:           hitSound.currentTime = 0;
84:           hitSound.play();
85:         }
86:       } else if (o.type === 'spike') {
87:         // spike is a triangle from the ground up
88:         const spikeX = o.x;
89:         const spikeWidth = 20;
90:         if (playerRect.x + playerRect.w > spikeX && playerRect.x < spikeX + spikeWidth) {
91:           // simple point-in-rectangle check for top of spike
92:           const spikeTopY = height - 30; // height of spike
93:           if (playerY + PLAYER_SIZE > spikeTopY) {
94:             gameOver = true;
95:             hitSound.currentTime = 0;
96:             hitSound.play();
97:           }
98:         }
99:       }
100:     }
101:   };
102: 
103:   const draw = () => {
104:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
105: 
106:     // background gradient
107:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
108:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1e1e2f');
109:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0a0a13');
110:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
111:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
112: 
113:     // ground with subtle shading
114:     const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, height - 10, 0, height);
115:     groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#555');
116:     groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
117:     ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
118:     ctx.fillRect(0, height - 10, width, 10);
119: 
120:     // player – small rounded square for a softer look
121:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
122:     ctx.beginPath();
123:     ctx.moveTo(40, playerY);
124:     ctx.lineTo(40 + PLAYER_SIZE, playerY);
125:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(40 + PLAYER_SIZE, playerY, 40 + PLAYER_SIZE, playerY + PLAYER_SIZE / 2);
126:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(40 + PLAYER_SIZE, playerY + PLAYER_SIZE, 40 + PLAYER_SIZE / 2, playerY + PLAYER_SIZE);
127:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(40, playerY + PLAYER_SIZE, 40, playerY + PLAYER_SIZE / 2);
128:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(40, playerY, 40, playerY);
129:     ctx.closePath();
130:     ctx.fill();
131: 
132:     // obstacles – enhanced visuals
133:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
134:       if (o.type === 'gap') {
135:         // draw a thin line to indicate gap edge
136:         ctx.strokeStyle = '#777';
137:         ctx.lineWidth = 2;
138:         ctx.beginPath();
139:         ctx.moveTo(o.x, height - 10);
140:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + 40, height - 10);
141:         ctx.stroke();
142:       } else if (o.type === 'spike') {
143:         const spikeGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(o.x, height - 30, o.x + 20, height - 10);
144:         spikeGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ff5555');
145:         spikeGrad.addColorStop(1, '#aa0000');
146:         ctx.fillStyle = spikeGrad;
147:         ctx.beginPath();
148:         ctx.moveTo(o.x, height - 10);
149:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + 10, height - 30);
150:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + 20, height - 10);
151:         ctx.closePath();
152:         ctx.fill();
153:       }
154:     });
155: 
156:     // score
157:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
158:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
159:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
160: 
161:     if (gameOver) {
162:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
163:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
164:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
165:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
166:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
167:     }
168:   };
169: 
170:   const loop = () => {
171:     update();
172:     draw();
173:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
174:   };
175: 
176:   // start
177:   loop();
178: })();
